cells.gaps: No published count of decisions, sanctions or complaints settled under the law for a stated period. The Alexandria Economic Court judgment (EGY-030) carries no date of its own: its last hearing was in October 2024 and EGY-012 places the ruling in February 2025; it is a civil damages award, not a decision of the Personal Data Protection Center. The compliance grace period ran to 31 October 2026 and full enforcement began in early November 2026 (EGY-036); no decision of the Center since is on record.
cells.note: The law is in force, fully enforced from November 2026 (EGY-036), and was applied in a 2025 court judgment ordering an operator to pay damages under Law 151 of 2020 (EGY-030), so stage 4 is met. No published count of decisions settles stage 5; the authority is constituted, so no cap applies.
